messages:
zoe (design): Noticed during hallway testing: model runs table on narrow screens shows a horizontal scrollbar and the collapsed left nav is overlapping the action buttons. Users can't tap 'Open' reliably on iPhone 8. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/ux-issue :grimacing:

ryan (frontend): can repro at 375x667. Looks like .actions-cell has min-width and the table doesn't wrap.

ada (product): This makes mobile triage pretty painful. We should make the mobile case first-class instead of relying on desktop CSS.

ken (mobile): two quick patterns that worked elsewhere: 1) move non-primary actions into a kebab menu for <=400px; 2) turn the sidebar into an overlay (position:fixed) instead of pushing content so it won't cover buttons. Overlay can be dismissible by swipe/down or X.

zoe (design): I prefer overlay + stacked rows: for widths <=420px, each row becomes label/value stacked lines with primary id on top, actions as a second line. Keeps tap targets stable. I'll add 320/375/414 mocks.

ryan (frontend): stacking is fine but we use react-window virtualization. If row heights vary, we need VariableSizeList or predictable collapsed heights. Alternative: keep single-height rows and show expanded details in an inline accordion on demand.

liz (qa): QA checklist: no horizontal scroll at 320/375/414; overlay focus trap; kebab touch target >=44px; landscape rotation check.

aria-a11y-bot: a11y note: overlay must be role="dialog" with aria-modal="true". When opening overlay or kebab, focus must move into it and be restored to trigger on close. Kebab should have aria-label="More actions for run". Announce state changes to screen readers.

ada (product): copy tweak: kebab menu item should read "Open details" not just "View". Drawer header: show short run id on first line, full model name truncated on second line (long press to reveal). Improves scanning.

ryan (frontend): plan: implement CSS @media (max-width:420px) to switch rows to stacked layout, show kebab for secondary actions, sidebar becomes overlay on small widths. Add ff: ff_mobile_table_layout toggle. Will keep virtualization by using row-level accordion to avoid variable heights in the list.

ken (mobile): remember to use safe-area-inset on the overlay for iOS (padding) and test swipe-to-close interactions with other gestures.

zoe (design): uploaded mocks to figma: https://figma.com/file/mobile-runs-stack. Acceptance criteria in ticket: no horizontal overflow at 320/375/414; kebab 44px min; overlay traps focus and restores on close; truncated names show full on long-press.

liz (qa): I'll add manual steps to the ticket and run tests once the FF is enabled in canary. Timeline?

ryan (frontend): aiming to open PR Wednesday, QA Thursday, ship Friday behind ff_mobile_table_layout.

zoe (design): thanks team, assigning follow-ups in the ticket. :thumbsup:
